    seeds = [int(s) for s in args.seeds.split(",")]
    perturbation_types = args.perturbation_types.split(",")

    # Load OpenPI policy (working baseline)
    from openpi_metabrain_policy import OpenPIMetaBrainPolicy
    log.info("Loading OpenPI policy...")
    policy_wrapper = OpenPIMetaBrainPolicy.from_checkpoint(
        checkpoint_path=args.pi0_checkpoint,
        routing_mode='none',
        device=device,
        use_delta_actions=True,
    )
    # Suppress diagnostic prints after first few
    policy_wrapper._diag_max = 2

    # Setup LoRA injector
    lora_injector = None
    router = None

    if args.routing == "universal" and args.lora_universal_dir:
        lora_injector = LoRAInjector(policy_wrapper.model, torch.device(device))
        lora_injector.load_adapter("universal", args.lora_universal_dir)
    elif args.routing == "par":
        lora_injector = LoRAInjector(policy_wrapper.model, torch.device(device))
        if args.lora_visual_dir:
            lora_injector.load_adapter("visual", args.lora_visual_dir)
        if args.lora_spatial_dir:
            lora_injector.load_adapter("spatial", args.lora_spatial_dir)
        if args.lora_physical_dir:
            lora_injector.load_adapter("physical", args.lora_physical_dir)
        if args.router_checkpoint:
            router = PARRouterLite(args.router_checkpoint, policy_wrapper.model, torch.device(device))
            log.info("PAR router loaded from %s", args.router_checkpoint)

    # Run evaluation
    all_results = {}
    for ptype in perturbation_types:
        log.info("Evaluating: %s (routing=%s)", ptype, args.routing)
        ptype_results = []

        for seed in seeds:
            for ep_idx in range(args.num_episodes):
                ep_seed = seed + ep_idx
                try:
                    result = run_episode(
                        policy_wrapper, lora_injector, args.routing, router,
                        args.task_suite, ptype, ep_seed,
                    )
                    ptype_results.append(result)
                    status = "OK" if result["success"] else "FAIL"
                    log.info("  [%s] seed=%d ep=%d/%d steps=%d %s",
                             ptype, seed, ep_idx+1, args.num_episodes, result["steps"], status)
                except Exception:
                    log.exception("  Episode failed: %s seed=%d ep=%d", ptype, seed, ep_idx)

        successes = sum(1 for r in ptype_results if r["success"])
        total = len(ptype_results)
        rate = successes / total if total > 0 else 0.0
        all_results[ptype] = {"success_rate": rate, "successes": successes, "total": total}
        log.info("  %s: %d/%d = %.1f%%", ptype, successes, total, rate * 100)

    # Print summary
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print(f"Eval Results  [routing={args.routing}]")
    print(f"{'='*70}")
    print(f"{'Perturbation':<25} {'3-Class':<10} {'Success Rate':<15} {'N':<6}")
    print(f"{'-'*25} {'-'*10} {'-'*15} {'-'*6}")
    for ptype, data in sorted(all_results.items()):
        cls3 = PERTURBATION_TO_3CLASS.get(ptype, ptype)
        rate = data["success_rate"]
        n = data["total"]
        print(f"{ptype:<25} {cls3:<10} {rate:>6.1%}         {n:<6}")
    total_s = sum(d["successes"] for d in all_results.values())
    total_n = sum(d["total"] for d in all_results.values())
    total_r = total_s / total_n if total_n > 0 else 0
    print(f"\n  {'OVERALL':<15} {total_r:>6.1%}  ({total_s}/{total_n})")
    print(f"{'='*70}\n")

    # Save JSON
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    out_path = output_dir / f"eval_{args.routing}_{args.task_suite}_{ts}.json"
    summary = {**all_results, "_meta": {
        "routing": args.routing, "task_suite": args.task_suite,
        "seeds": seeds, "num_episodes": args.num_episodes, "timestamp": ts,
    }}
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    log.info("Results saved to %s", out_path)

    policy_wrapper.cleanup()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
